release_highlights: Adds one-radio frequency information with direct CI-V or Hamlib/rigctld; configured radio auto-connect is non-fatal on failure.
Adds a compact MHz frequency display and opt-in RMKS1/RMKS2/Band auto-set on callsign RETURN; MODE is never changed.
Contest RMKS1 is protected from frequency auto-set; free-radio tabs do not consume amateur-radio auto-set.
Adds an experimental single-client CI-V virtual COM relay using an already-installed com0com setupc.exe; preferred port is physical+200 then +100 on conflict.
PSLog-created virtual pairs are removed on normal shutdown and stale-state cleanup is attempted at the next startup after an abnormal exit.
Hamlib frequency acquisition is supported via rigctld; Ver1.16 virtual COM relay is intentionally CI-V only.
Existing contest log edits and QSL workbench saves preserve nonnumeric contest exchange values in RST fields while ordinary QSO validation remains strict.
